goal: Turn a reproducible defect into a verified PR awaiting merge.

requires.pinned-source: The repository and immutable revision are available to authorized workers.
requires.isolated-tests: The project has a bounded test command and isolated candidate workspace.

excludes.emergency-bypass: An emergency exception needs a separately reviewed definition and approval policy.

roles.sdlc-owner: Reviews exact template versions and regression evidence before publication.
roles.delivery-reviewer: Reviews the bound candidate, checks and source before authorizing delivery.
roles.worker: Uses scoped capability grants to prepare artifacts, execute tests and deliver only authorized effects.

request.description: Concrete business request and its testable acceptance criterion.

revision.description: Immutable source revision; provider must compare it at delivery.

deliverables.candidate: Immutable workspace, design/context lineage and repair diagnostics.
deliverables.tests: Typed independent test reports bound to current inputs and source.
deliverables.acceptance: Verified run acceptance manifest, approvals and any provider receipts.

exception_paths.success: Tests pass, independent verification passes and the bound human review approves; delivery reaches its terminal acceptance gate.
exception_paths.rework: A failed first test sends its actual candidate and diagnostics to one repair attempt; repeated failure ends the run.
exception_paths.rejected: The reviewer rejects the candidate; cancel without delivery.
exception_paths.timed_out: The five-minute timeboxed review expires durably; fail without delivery. Longer review windows require a new reviewed template version.
exception_paths.failed: Repeated test failure terminates. Release smoke-test failure compensates the exact original deployment receipt; ambiguous effects remain queryable for recovery.

capabilities.usage: Create a provider-backed PR from reviewed immutable proposal artifacts; return its stable identity. Leave it awaiting merge.
Query the immutable original operation key; return provider-backed effect protocol observations, never execute a write.
Read the pinned source and request; return an immutable workspace/design artifact. No writes to the source repository.
Produce an immutable candidate workspace from the context and previous test diagnostics. Never merge or publish.
Run the candidate tests in an isolated workspace; return the observed Boolean, diagnostics and a typed test report.
Independently execute candidate tests; bind the typed report, release subject and review digest to these exact inputs and artifacts. No model or external write.
